Messages.Body:
If an action passes with stealth and I block with a second vampire, must the
oponent play new stealth cards or can he continue the
action with the same stelth cards?

Miguel

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:


Stealth and intercept bonuses do not zero out until the action has successfully
completed (or not). The vampire will still enjoy its increased stealth.
